the horns over the pines i rented the cabin because id honestly been tired of working my ass off at my job and needed a cheap retreat to nature that wouldnt cause much of a dent to my wallet the listing had said it was quiet and secluded and the images showed a tranquil forest nestled in the hills obviously i caught the latest booking the cabin sits in a bowl of hills thick with pine trees and fauna during the day it feels normal enough the stove works the floorboards creaks but not enough to annoy you the owner was kind enough to leave a tv with an old ps4 still hooked up to it with a few games on the shelf next to it theres even a guest book on the table with smiley faces and notes about hiking trails the first night i heard something roar my first conclusion was a bear but it didnt take me long to know it wasnt i had grown up around bears this wasnt it this sound had a shape to it ripping through the air with a sheer ferocity that seemed to shake the floorboards it rose to a crescendo dipped then finally ended in a low deep reverberation that rolled through the trees causing the leaves to audibly sway i looked out the window between the pines on the far hill something shifted at first i thought it was two trees standing taller than the others then one of them moved independently thats when i saw the horns they were too tall thats the only way i can describe it antlers branch goat horns curl these were long smooth arcs that rose straight up appearing like black silhouettes against the starry night below them i saw the rough figure of a deers face obscured by the distance and dark it took me a long time to fall asleep again and the next morning i wonder if it was a dream i went about my day exploring the woods albeit now with a certain degree of caution reading books by the fireplace and playing games till twelve o clock the next night my theory was disproven when i heard the guttural roars yet again they werent constant they came in intervals spaced just far enough apart that my body never relaxed enough to fall intothe comforting embrace of sleep instead i found myself holding my breath wide awake waiting for the next road i shut off all the lights and didnt dare to look out the windows for a long long time i gathered up the courage to look outside yet again only when the roars stopped tonight the horned beast seemed to be moving i could see the thing moving aimlessly along the treeline until i saw it turn it heads in the direction of the cabin my heart raced as it crawled up my neck it almost stopped beating when i thought i noticed it lock eyes with me i closed the curtains then and there turning my back to the walls and burying my face in my knees wishing my heart would calm the hell down i packed my stuff in the car before sunset today i threw things in the back with haste and determination id planned to spend the whole week here so it took a while for me to pack up all of my fishing gear hiking stuff clothes etcetera even when racing against the clock i kept telling myself id leave at first light i didnt want to drive those roads at night not with that damn fog already thickening let alone the fact that my my hands were still shaking from pure adrenaline and booze coursing through my blood vessels that was the mistake i assumed distance mattered i assumed whatever it was stayed in the hills stayed out there it wouldnt needlessly pass its territory right i delusioned myself with this mantra the roars started earlier tonight not from the hills this time no it was from the treeline just beyond the clearing i didnt dare to go outside i didnt look out the windows i shut the curtains turned off every light and sat on the edge of the bed with my keys in my hand like they could protect me the sound neared it was loud louder than anything id ever heard my ear was threatening to burst it was closer in a way that made my skin crawl the sense of impending doom overtaking me heavy footfall and the crunching of leaves added to that it was strong the ground shook with each step it took something scraped against the cabins exterior sharp claws scratching loudly against the wood even through the curtains i could see the shadows long changing silhouettes covered the small bedroom through the gap in the curtains i could see a bit oh god i could see its abdomen hidden by the shadows the windows were more than six feet above the ground it was tall i realized then that it wasnt going away somehow it knows im here and i think its hungry the roars stopped in their place came a low sound that vibrated through the floorboards it was a low guttural growl i finally slid under the bed when the porch creaked something heavy leaned against the front of the cabin the wood groaned a deep exhausted sound i pressed my phone to my chest every muscle locked listening as the footsteps moved slowly across the porch then the front door exploded inward my heart threatening to leap out of my chest i began to sob as silently as i could if you see this heed my warning dont stay any longer in the woods if you see horns over the trees it wont stay there for long its probably already seen you after all it doesnt need to rush its hunting you oh god i can see its feet from beneath the bed

intercepting moving comets placing a beacon on them and selling access to miners and combat pilots mining the comet is hard because it is moving time limited and highly valuable which naturally explorers something meaningful and unique to do step 1 scanning the void as an explorer i scan large empty regions of space for faint moving signatures comets are not static they move at higher speed across the system to understand where a comet is going i have to place scanning beacons in deep space to triangulate its speed and direction after loosely identifying their locationsector they are in alternatively i can buy scanning capacity from stations and comm arrays i have to scan multiple times over a period of time to calculate its trajectory as a side effect this triangulation would also reveal very large moving signatures like capital ships possibly creating a secondary purpose for explorers step 2 intercept quantum travel because the comet is moving a normal quantum jump to a fixed coordinate does not work by the time i arrive the comet would be somewhere else exploration ships could have a quantum mode that allows intercept jumps onto moving targets instead of static locations technically its a static location the exploration vessels special quantum computer is able to calculate the proper location by using the triangulated data step 3 placing the tracking beacon i then miners cargo haulers mobile refiners and combat pilots all have a reason to be there at the same time also an attractive target for pirates since jumping multiple times between the comet and a station for unloading isnt efficient miners would have to unload at the comet this creates a natural time limited hotspot in deep space that is entirely player driven this would give exploration ships a real
